name: 🍆 Chicken & Eggplant Parm
tagline: Crispy panko chicken and eggplant, Rao's, bubbling mozzarella. The oven does the frying.

items.name: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, dried oregano

steps.text: Oven to 425°F. Line 2 sheet pans with foil and oil them well.
Slice the eggplant into ½-inch rounds; salt and set aside 10 minutes. If the chicken breasts are thick, slice them in half the long way.
Set up three plates: flour; eggs beaten with a splash of water; panko mixed with half the parmesan, oregano, garlic powder, salt.
Dredge chicken and patted-dry eggplant: flour, egg, panko. Lay on the pans and spray or drizzle the tops with oil.
Spoon sauce over each piece, top with mozzarella and parmesan, and bake until bubbly.
Warm the rest of the sauce for pasta, if serving.

kid_jobs.job: Bread the eggplant (dry hand, wet hand)
Spoon on the sauce and cheese
Cook the pasta with a grown-up

chef_tip: Salt the eggplant and pat it dry before breading. It pulls out bitterness and water, so it bakes up crisp instead of soggy.
make_ahead: Bread everything in the morning and refrigerate on the pans; bake when you get home.
leftovers: Parm sandwiches on a demi baguette or bolillo roll for lunch.
swaps: WF chicken scallopini (i384) skips the slicing
serve_with: Spaghetti or fusilli, and a simple salad
heads_up: Oven to 425°F and salt the eggplant first.
